study type: Retrospective Cohort Study with comparison group
cohort: The study included pregnant women with uncorrected single ventricles and healthy concurrent controls managed between 2011 and 2017.
finding: Perinatal loss and low-birth weight rates were higher among women with a single ventricle compared to healthy controls.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were similar between women with uncorrected single ventricles and healthy controls.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome (low-birth weight rates)
